document.title: Data quality repair rules
document.text: Exact duplicate rows may be removed only in an approved derived copy. Whitespace cells may be trimmed when the reviewer accepts the preview. Spreadsheet formula cells must be escaped before spreadsheet export. Duplicate key values with conflicting records require manual reconciliation. Type errors and unknown enum values must not be guessed. Preserve the source dataset and report remaining issues.

distractors.title: Dataset retention
distractors.text: Dataset retention and archive requirements apply to stored imports. Keep archived versions for the agreed retention period. Retention does not authorize changing invalid record values.
